name: Test pack: fantasy
description: Small content for engine development and automated tests, in a classical fantasy setting: a smithy and a cold cellar with rats, in plain names. The twin of the sci-fi test pack.
help: A smithy and its cellar. You start with a sword and no armour: put the leather armour on anywhere, but blessings only take at the altar. The cellar is cold without something warm; the witch trades a fur cloak for iron and may join you. Mana spent on spells comes back a little each round; stamina rises with every swing and falls back as you catch your breath.
